parsed.rationale: The Quotient - /crypto/live API directly provides live cryptocurrency data including price, change, and other market info for specified symbols like Binance USD (BUSD). It matches the subtask intent to fetch detailed latest crypto info and accepts a symbol parameter that can be set to Binance USD. Other APIs are either unrelated to Binance USD or provide only partial or unrelated data.
